# App Bridge types {#app-bridge-types}

App Bridge pages पर इस्तेमाल होने वाले types, और वे सभी types जिन्हें ये reference करते हैं, [`@shopify/app-bridge-types`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shopify/app-bridge-types) 0.7.5 से लिए गए हैं। `polaris-vue-elements/app-bridge` उन types को re-export करता है जिन्हें package export करता है। विवरण Shopify का अपना JSDoc हैं, अंग्रेज़ी में।

- [Authentication और data](/hi/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data): [`AppApi`](/hi/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#appapi), [`AppBridgeConfig`](/hi/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#appbridgeconfig), [`EnvironmentApi`](/hi/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#environmentapi), [`IdTokenApi`](/hi/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#idtokenapi), [`Scopes`](/hi/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#scopes), [`UserApi`](/hi/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#userapi)

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">sidekick</span>: <a href="/hi/app-bridge/types/user-interface-and-interactions#sidekickapi">SidekickApi</a></code></p>

Start Sidekick conversations for the merchant from your app.

`shopify.sidekick` is always defined, but its methods reject when Sidekick isn't available to the app, for example in the Shopify mobile app or on a store without Sidekick. Feature-detect with `isEnabled()` and treat a rejection as unavailable.

</div>

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">tools</span>: <a href="/hi/app-bridge/types/user-interface-and-interactions#tools">Tools</a></code></p>

Entry point for Shopify tools.

Enables apps to bind runtime handler functions for tools already declared in app extension configuration, which can be invoked by the platform on behalf of the app. Registered tools are scoped to the current app and persist for the lifetime of the app or until explicitly removed.

</div>
